newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil down, fuel oil steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil down, fuel oil steady.

text.p: NWE gas oil fell on Tuesday while fuel oil, the only product with active buyers, remained steady.

Heating oil barges were down about $3 a tonne, mainly on underlying IPE futures weakness. Premiums softened about 50 cents as buyers remained apathetic and more sellers appeared. First half September deliveries were offered at IPE Sept +$4.50 fob ARA, with second half deliveries at +$1.25/+$1.50.
High sulphur fuel oil traded early at $112 and $113 fob ARA, little changed from Monday's close. Dealers said bunker demand was likely to total 7,000-8,000 tonnes.
